fixture_construction: For each guard start from a fully valid independently sourced case. Change exactly one semantic invariant; regenerate unrelated copies, envelope producer digests, original full-value/frame commitments and post-state through the valid builder so no unrelated predicate is broken. Never accept caller-supplied validity flags as original custody. Separate writer, exact retained-reader and projector paths. Every negative must reject with its target guard enabled and pass only when that predicate is removed using the shared tool. No local proof code in phase 1.
duplicates: Only the same field and predicate at multiple sites form a duplicate set. Demonstrate each site removed alone still rejects and all identical sites removed passes. Split compound/allOf rules per predicate, not per keyword or refusal code. Never merge distinct predicates through a shared site.

positives: current exact-family writer after actual admission prerequisites close
same-body lost-ack retry returns original result
retained valid older history after live epoch/state/identity/recipe change
retained authentic projector_replay_only accepted by compatibility reader only
empty source, zero family matches in nonempty source, complete matching range and degraded survivor range remain distinct
full record/payload/operation above 16 KiB uses the existing SP-337 route
crash boundaries before/after owner body, append sync, first-receipt custody, terminal result, projection CAS; every cut preserves outcome or disclosed unavailability

families.atomic_schema_note: Enum/const are a single exact-value/type predicate, with no redundant schema type site. Requiredness, lengths, characters, numeric bounds and array properties are distinct predicates. Nested reference/union branches and inherited original schemas are expanded by the reviewed phase-2 tool before proof; no whole-keyword deletion counts as a proof.

current_writer_applicability.assignment_epoch: Original source epoch equals the current owning assignment epoch before a fresh append/callback; retry returns only authenticated prior success and creates no fresh effect.
current_writer_applicability.Stop: Check effective Stop for this exact owner operation; an authorized stop/clearance control may persist its own result but cannot authorize ordinary callbacks.
current_writer_applicability.history: Current writer admission gates never reject an authentic retained original solely because live permission, Stop, owner/writer generation or epoch changed; present reader access/deletion/withdrawal still applies.

full record/payload/operation above 16 KiB uses the existing SP-337 route

retention.positive: Runtime run-completion +365 days inclusive, cap edges, successor links and every hold; pending policy never admits deletion or event admission

negative.one_defect: Restart an expiry anchor on retry, or infer a destructive rule for a pending policy, as separate cases

families.atomic_schema_note: Enum/const are a single exact-value/type predicate, with no redundant schema type site. Requiredness, lengths, characters, numeric bounds and array properties are distinct predicates. Nested reference/union branches and inherited original schemas are expanded by the reviewed phase-2 tool before proof; no whole-keyword deletion counts as a proof.

current_writer_applicability.assignment_epoch: Original source epoch equals the current owning assignment epoch before a fresh append/callback; retry returns only authenticated prior success and creates no fresh effect.
current_writer_applicability.Stop: Check effective Stop for this exact owner operation; an authorized stop/clearance control may persist its own result but cannot authorize ordinary callbacks.
current_writer_applicability.history: Current writer admission gates never reject an authentic retained original solely because live permission, Stop, owner/writer generation or epoch changed; present reader access/deletion/withdrawal still applies.

empty source, zero family matches in nonempty source, complete matching range and degraded survivor range remain distinct
full record/payload/operation above 16 KiB uses the existing SP-337 route
crash boundaries before/after owner body, append sync, first-receipt custody, terminal result, projection CAS; every cut preserves outcome or disclosed unavailability
epoch_replaced clearance binds the old held finding to the authentic current replacement control; valid old-epoch history still reads after that replacement

Requiredness, lengths, characters, numeric bounds and array properties are distinct predicates. Nested reference/union branches and inherited original schemas are expanded by the reviewed phase-2 tool before proof; no whole-keyword deletion counts as a proof.
